subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction plugin hooks gain a permanent current-session reset API that is supported across OpenClaw, Codex, and Copilot compaction paths?
rationale: This is a new plugin lifecycle capability with session-destruction semantics; prior broader reset API work closed unmerged, so implementation quality cannot establish the intended permanent contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Approve current-session-only deferred resets, then require removal of unrelated behavior, public contract documentation, focused compatibility tests, and exact-head runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep resets host-internal
options.body: Reject the plugin API and expose only a narrower owner-specific compaction recovery seam that does not let general hook code request session rotation.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle API design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define a broader plugin session-lifecycle contract and migration policy covering reset, compaction, and locked sessions.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Approve current-session-only deferred resets, then require removal of unrelated behavior, public contract documentation, focused compatibility tests, and exact-head runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person most directly to both the gateway reset service and bundled Codex/harness lifecycle integration.
